The Hunter Valley stallion parades concluded on Sunday after four days of viewing some of the country's finest horseflesh, all within roughly an hour's drive of one another. Visitors to Vinery Stud, Arrowfield Stud, Widden Stud, and Coolmore Stud highlighted who they most loved seeing this weekend.

In this instalment of Stable Tours, TTR catches up with Lucy Yeomans as Changing Colours is the star of her young team. With the stable having a focus on providing affordable opportunities, a patient development approach and the aim of placing horses to win, Yeomans is building an exciting future.

It will be a Breeders' Cup swansong for Notable Speech after the Godolphin stalwart added a sixth Group 1 win to his record with the G1 City Of York Stakes on Saturday. Stateside, Medaglia D'Oro notched a 100th Graded/Group winner with Tam Tam in the G1 Del Mar Oaks.

A clash of titans happened in the opening Group 1 of the racing season, and it was star mare Autumn Glow who emerged victorious in the G1 Winx Stakes, handing Chris Waller a 10th win in the race. Midnight In Tokyo upgraded herself yet again when dominating the G3 Show County Quality, and Cavalry Girl books a G1 Moir Stakes tilt after winning the G3 Carlyon Stakes at Sandown.

The first leg of the Darley Princess Series was absolutely conquered by Tony Gollan's gutsy filly Pembrey, who now chases the G2 Furious Stakes in two weeks' time. Judas Tree served up a Godolphin quinella in the first race at Sandown, and later on the card, the progressive Buggsy aided Craig Williams in securing a four-timer.

The covering season is just days away and the annual stallion parades in the Hunter Valley provide a last opportunity to physically assess who's going in your mating plans this spring. In Part 1, those who attended parades at Yarraman Park Stud, Newgate Farm, Darley, and Yulong's Segenhoe farm tell us who caught their eye this weekend.

USA sensation Bacio won the G1 Nunthorpe from former shuttler Starlust with European Champion Sprinter Asfoora brave in defeat. She will be retired. Arapaho Gold gave first season sire Bayside Boy his first group winner in the G2 Gimcrack Stakes.

The G1 Winx Stakes headlines a stellar Saturday at Randwick as Autumn Glow and Sheza Alibi finally meet, while there is plenty of other interest with a strong black type undercard, and Sandown provides a solid back-up with some strong potential spring prospects stepping out.
